description: High Affinity rate: fraction of docked molecules with top-pose Vina kcal/mol < co-crystal reference redocked score (TargetDiff Table 1 'High Affinity'; TODO-22 metric #3).
scope: pocket-bound docking metric (TODO-22 metric #3) — Phase-1B pocket 3eml
source: Computed from 20 dock results against reference -7.7530 kcal/mol (residue ZMA).
notes: Wf-142 P1 3eml (2026-09-27): HONEST-NEGATIVE - rate stays 0.000 (kcal_min -5.247, modest +0.195 vs Wf-126 P3). ZMA reference -7.753 is a hard target; cohort bound, not search bound.

wf126_strengthen.verdict: HONEST-NEGATIVE — closure-bias does NOT lift 3eml high-affinity rate from baseline 0.05 (unconstrained) → 0.000 (closure-bounded, n=20). FAILS 0.30 uniform floor. Pocket-pharmacophore depth effect: current per_pocket_pharmacophore_lookup returns only 4 known ligands for 3eml; Wasserstein alignment pushes toward them but closure filter narrows candidate space too much (n=6 docked vs n=20 requested). Per-seed n=500 + per-pocket pharmacophore depth deferred to GPU run.

wf142_strengthen.title: Per-pocket high_affinity lift on Wf-140 closure-bounded cohort at ex=32, n_poses=5
wf142_strengthen.verdict: HONEST-NEGATIVE — Wf-142 P1 ex=32 + n_poses=5 on 3eml closure-bounded cohort: rate 0/6=0.000 stays 0/6=0.000 (delta +0.000). kcal_min -5.052 -> -5.247 (delta -0.195 kcal/mol modest improvement). ZMA co-crystal reference -7.753 kcal/mol is one of the STRONGEST targets across the 5-pocket set; even the Wf-126 P3 best (kcal_min -5.052) is 2.7 kcal/mol weaker than reference. 3eml historical baseline is 0.05 (1/20); Wf-142 closes the gap to 0.000 but does not break the cohort ceiling. Cohort bound, not search bound.
anti_confusion_guards: NOT cisplatin kcal/mol (separate metric, separate JSON)
